item.text:
**5B.8 Research Note: Fair Distribution of Economic Gains**
**Bottom line:** mixed, leaning negative. Tinubu’s 2024 record contains several broad, need-based distribution measures, but the year is dominated by severe inflation, food stress, selective relief, elite/family favoritism signals, and a coercive environment that cut against equal sharing.

**Positive evidence**
- **World Bank Approves New Financing for Nigeria to Improve Health Outcomes, Safety of Dams, and Irrigation Services** | World Bank | 2024-09-26 | https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/09/26/world-bank-approves-new-financing-for-nigeria-to-improve-health-outcomes-safety-of-dams-and-irrigation-services  
  The package targeted health, basic education governance, and irrigation/hydropower resilience, explicitly aiming at service delivery bottlenecks that affect poorer households and lagging areas. This is strong evidence for broader public-goods distribution.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.6`

- **Supporting Nigeria’s Homegrown Reforms: New World Bank Financing for Inclusive Growth and Revenue Diversification** | World Bank | 2024-06-13 | https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/13/supporting-nigeria-homegrown-reforms-new-world-bank-financing-for-inclusive-growth-and-revenue-diversification  
  The Bank said the reform package was meant to raise non-oil revenue, safeguard oil revenue, create fiscal space for public services, and scale up support to vulnerable households. This supports a fair-distribution reading in intent, especially for poorer groups.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.3`, `5B.4`, `5B.6`

- **President Tinubu Directs Expeditious Processing of Welfare Benefits, Demands Monthly KPI Reports** | State House | 2024-02-22 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-expeditious-processing-of-welfare-benefits-demands-monthly-kpi-reports/  
  Tinubu ordered faster delivery of welfare benefits, warned against delays harming vulnerable citizens, and required monthly KPI reporting. This is direct administrative evidence of pro-poor intent, though it is about process rather than observed outcomes.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.6`, `5B.7`

- **President Tinubu Establishes National Education Data System and Approves Skill Development for all Levels of Education, Teacher’s Training and Support Nationwide** | State House | 2024-04-18 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-national-education-data-system-and-approves-skill-development-for-all-levels-of-education-teachers-training-and-support-nationwide/  
  The education package focused on out-of-school children, teacher training, skill acquisition, and a national data system. That is a broad-based human-capital intervention aimed at children and lower-income families rather than supporters alone.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.6`

- **President Tinubu Launches National Resettlement Scheme For Conflict Victims** | State House | 2024-07-06 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-launches-national-resettlement-scheme-for-conflict-victims/  
  The resettlement scheme explicitly targeted displaced and conflict-affected communities in multiple states and framed the effort as rehabilitation and reintegration. This is the clearest 2024 evidence for distribution to a vulnerable group that is not just party allies.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.6`

- **President Tinubu Launches Education Campaign: No Child Should Be Excluded From Learning** | State House | 2024-05-13 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-launches-education-campaign-sys-no-child-should-be-excluded-from-learning/  
  Tinubu backed women’s rights, anti-GBV policy, and girls’ education in safe environments. This is positive evidence for gender-inclusive distribution, though it is mostly programmatic rhetoric.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.6`

- **Tinubu Creates Comprehensive Economic Coordination and Planning System for Nigeria** | State House | 2024-03-27 | https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-establishes-comprehensive-economic-coordination-and-planning-system-for-nigeria/  
  PECC/EET put technocrats and private-sector figures at the center of macro coordination. This matters for distribution because it suggests resource-allocation choices were being managed through formal institutions rather than only patronage networks.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.6`, `5B.7`

**Negative evidence**
- **Tinubu under fire for appointing son-in-law head of housing agency** | BusinessDay | 2024-02-21 | https://businessday.ng/news/article/tinubu-under-fire-for-appointing-son-in-law-head-of-housing-agency/  
  The son-in-law appointment to the Federal Housing Authority is the clearest nepotism signal in the 2024 record. It directly cuts against the claim that economic gains and positions were distributed without privileging connected insiders.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.5`, `5B.7`

- **Hundreds Gather Across Nigerian Cities to Protest Cost-of-Living Crisis** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-01 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/hundreds-gather-across-nigerian-cities-to-protest-cost-of-living-crisis-3548376  
  Reuters tied the protests to subsidy removal, naira devaluation, electricity tariffs, and inflation above 34 percent. That is strong evidence that gains were not landing fairly across classes and that poorer households bore the pain.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.3`, `5B.4`, `5B.6`

- **Insecurity, Rising Costs Push 31 Million Nigerians into Acute Food Shortage** | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-27 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/insecurity-rising-costs-push-31-million-nigerians-into-acute-food-shortage-study-says-3589474  
  The acute-food-shortage scale is strong negative evidence for equitable distribution because it shows the reform path had not yet protected the most vulnerable.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.3`, `5B.6`

- **FG Spent N63.6bn on Military Equipment in Seven Months - Report** | Punch | 2024-08-17 | https://punchng.com/fg-spent-n63-6bn-on-military-equipment-in-seven-months-report/  
  Large, weakly disclosed security spending raises diversion and opportunity-cost concerns. Even if security-driven, it weakens the case that public resources were being spread fairly toward broad welfare rather than opaque, high-priority channels.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.3`, `5B.5`, `5B.6`

- **Nigeria Charges Protesters With Treason and Mutiny After August Demonstrations** | Reuters via ThePrint | 2024-09-02 | https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/  
  Treating protesters as mutineers is evidence of a punitive climate toward non-supporters. That does not directly measure spending distribution, but it strongly suggests the state was not equally protective of dissenting groups.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.5`, `5B.7`

- **Nigeria Police Charge 4 Journalists With Cybercrimes for Corruption Reporting** | CPJ | 2024-10-03 | https://cpj.org/2024/10/nigeria-police-charge-4-journalists-with-cybercrimes-for-corruption-reporting/  
  Press intimidation weakens scrutiny over who benefits from policy and who captures rents. It is indirect, but it cuts against fair distribution because it chills oversight of elite advantage.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.5`, `5B.7`

- **Amnesty Says Police Used Excessive Force to Violently Quash Endbadgovernance Protests** | Amnesty International | 2024-11-28 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/  
  Amnesty documented killings and mass detentions during the crackdown. That is negative evidence for fairness across groups because the state responded coercively to largely lower-income protest grievances.  
  IDs: `5B.8`, also `5B.4`, `5B.5`, `5B.7`

**Search gap**
- I found strong evidence on program design and macro outcomes, but little direct 2024 evidence showing actual subgroup-by-subgroup distribution of benefits by region, class, or gender.
- There is no clean 2024 dataset here showing whether specific regions systematically captured more gains, or whether opposition supporters were excluded from benefits in a measurable way.
- So the best-supported conclusion is mixed: Tinubu had multiple inclusive policy designs, but actual 2024 outcomes remained highly unequal and the record contains real patronage/favoritism and regressive-cost signals.
